recentItems.title: Recorder Readiness Webinar
recentItems.description:
Have you ever wondered how to build music literacy on the soprano recorder? Join us for this interactive session as music educator and author Danielle Bayert teaches participants how to create flexible and skilled musicians on the soprano recorder. Follow along with activities that build skills in pitch recognition, rhythm work, and recorder technique, and learn creative ways to mix and match these skills for today's elementary musician. You'll be sure to walk away with dozens of fun activities to spice up your current recorder curriculum!

recentItems.title: Upleveling your Teaching with Anatomy - An Introduction to Timani with Dr. Hannah Murray
recentItems.description:
This is a unique opportunity to learn about a musical training system that is extremely new to the United States but is increasingly popular in European conservatories and orchestras. In this session, participants will learn some of the basic concepts of Timani, a movement system from Norway designed explicitly to help musicians understand and optimize their physical motions to use their bodies best while practicing and performing.
 
We will discuss relevant and applicable anatomy for music-making and explore a few simple and accessible exercises that can easily be incorporated into a range of teaching and playing environments. This session will be part lecture, part workshop, and, if time permits, part masterclass. All participants are encouraged to bring their instruments and actively participate in the session.
